decisions.decision_basis: No architecture ambiguity beyond OpenClaw version and gateway model freeze.
Memory slot replacement path is publicly documented and can be frozen with explicit embedding config.

strict_upgrade_blockers: Need a public immutable legacy memory-openviking snapshot that can be uniquely tied to the official row3 result line.
Need a public evidence chain showing the vendored legacy path matches the official historical integration rather than the newer context-engine path.
decisions.decision_basis: A public immutable legacy memory-openviking snapshot is vendored, but the official result table has not yet been uniquely tied to this exact public snapshot. Upgrade to strict only after public equivalence evidence is added.

structural_gaps: The current public openviking plugin is a context-engine plugin, while the historical official row4 implementation is not publicly proven to be this exact path.
The vendored current public context-engine snapshot declares minOpenvikingVersion 0.2.9, while the official README result table reports OpenViking 0.1.18.
decisions.decision_basis: Current public coexistence path is memory-core + contextEngine=openviking, but the public context-engine snapshot is not proven identical to the historical official row4 implementation and its declared runtime floor (OpenViking >= 0.2.9) does not match the official 0.1.18 table row.
Any manifest or code modification of legacy memory-openviking keeps the run permanently exploratory.
